   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  AUGUST 12, 2024

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 5:57 p.m. Responding to roll call were Commissioner
Beacham and Commissioner Sanchez. Vice Chair Ang was absent. Also present was Rosalee Santa
Ana, Senior Management Analyst, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Jocelyn Hernandez,
Communications Specialist and Public Safety Commissioners Michael Rosoff, Kim Apodaca, and
Stephanie Rodriguez.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Leon made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes
for July 8, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responder’s Appreciation Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda presented Commissioners two versions of the flyer invitation for the event to choose
from and decided on one. Mrs. Ocegueda gave updates on food quotes but will have a final list at the
next meeting. Mrs. Ocegueda showed Commissioners the meal/raffle tickets and how they were to be
used. Centerpiece designs were discussed, Commissioners asked Mrs. Ocegueda to bring an example
of a bucket filled with candy with a mini flag in the middle. Commissioner Sanchez would like to bring
back the paper placemats decorated by school children that was done in previous years. Both
Commissioner Beacham and Sanchez stated they will reach out to schools and contact Mrs. Ocegueda
if placemats need to be purchased.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the July Mini Mart Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda stated that staff will be out this week to start filming the next edition.
Chair Leon praised staff on the reels that were being released to encourage more voting.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month. Commissioner Beacham asked what
events in June led to the negative numbers. Ms. Santa Ana responded that she believes the firework
warnings/complaints and the motorcycle warnings led to the negative responses.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Beacham reminded staff to have the 2025 Meet & Greet on the agenda for November
or December to discuss theme and customized party favors/appreciation items. Commissioner
Sanchez stated he attended the Grand Opening and Art Unveiling events at Milagros Cinema and

praised them for the renovations done to the theatre. Commissioner Sanchez also reminded everyone
that the Arturo Sanchez Sr. Halloween Parade will be held on October 12th and on Saturday, August
17 there will be a Senior Health Fair at Cerritos College hosted by Representative Linda Sanchez. Chair
Leon volunteered at the backpack giveaway at John Glenn High School. Chair Leon said it was very
well attended as they did a great job at promoting the event.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:12 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
